answer: Falcon-Divergence Identity Hold: each agent identity must periodically answer a secret challenge whose correct response depends on its full interaction history. Clones share history, so they cannot diverge; a sybil cluster either fails the walnut check or must fork a separate history. Honest divergence is allowed only when anchored at a real branching event, verified against a public wharf log of ancestry roots. Each extra identity therefore costs a full independent history replay plus log anchoring, paid per clone.
